agents.install.sudo_hint: Installation requires root. sudo is not needed in a root session; if sudo is not installed (common on CentOS, Debian and Alpine), leave the box unchecked. The Debian and Alpine commands use wget instead of curl. Run the Windows command in PowerShell or a command prompt opened as administrator.

agents.install.offline_body: Download the files from these addresses, copy them to the server and run the install script with the --binary option:
agents.install.supported_body: Inventory and updates: every distribution using apt (Debian, Ubuntu), dnf/yum (RHEL, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux), zypper (SUSE, openSUSE) or apk (Alpine) with systemd or OpenRC (including CentOS, Oracle Linux and Fedora), and Windows 10, Windows 11 and Windows Server 2016 / 2019 / 2022 / 2025 (x64, Windows Update). Physical server, VMware, Hyper-V, KVM/Proxmox or cloud makes no difference. Vulnerability scanning: Debian, Ubuntu, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CloudLinux 8/9 (with AlmaLinux data), SUSE Linux Enterprise, openSUSE Leap, Alpine and Windows (CVEs of pending Microsoft updates; third-party Windows programs are not scanned).

selfupdate.warning: The updater has access to the Docker socket, which equals root access on the server. It only waits for the request file the dashboard writes and runs fixed steps; it opens no port. Protect administrator accounts with two-factor authentication.

compliance.check.agent.coverage.fix: Make sure agents connect every day: check network access, the service state and offline alerts.
compliance.check.patch.applied.fix: Review the output of failed update jobs and retry the remaining packages; define a regular update schedule.
compliance.check.patch.currency.fix: Apply pending security updates with scheduled or rolling updates.
compliance.check.vuln.sla.fix: Prioritize overdue findings; define the targets in the system settings.
compliance.check.vuln.kev.fix: Resolve vulnerabilities in the CISA KEV catalog before their due date.
compliance.check.risk.accepted.fix: Give every accepted risk a reason and an end date.
compliance.check.eol.unsupported.fix: Upgrade end-of-life operating systems to a supported release or add evidence of extended support.
compliance.check.reboot.pending.fix: Reboot systems that wait for a reboot after an update in a maintenance window.
compliance.check.change.recorded.fix: Make changes through netio.patchman jobs, schedules or rolling updates.
compliance.check.change.approval.fix: Require a preview approval before updates in the system settings.
compliance.check.config.drift.fix: Define server standards and resolve the deviations found.
compliance.check.access.mfa.fix: Enable and require two-step verification for every administrator.
compliance.check.backup.daily.fix: Turn on automatic backups and fix the cause of failed backups.
compliance.check.log.integrity.fix: Investigate the break in the evidence chain and any direct change to the database.
compliance.check.monitoring.coverage.fix: Turn on continuous monitoring and check that every agent reports its resources.
